facility.name: Little Steps Academy
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Before School Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Drop-In Care,Part Time Care,Transportation to/from School ,Field Trips

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 3121 FOREST AVE, FORT WORTH, TX, 76112

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Licensed Operations Required Fees: Operation has not paid background check fee.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Licensed Operations Required Fees (26 TAC §745.509)

occurrences.finding: Infant Daily Report - Times and Amount of Food: Based on the investigation findings, this standard was reviewed and found to be in non-compliance with The Minimum Standards for Child Care Centers. The operation was not providing an infant daily report to the parents of infants ages 0-17 months old noting the times and amount of food the infant was ingesting. The operation has since been providing this information to the parents of the children in the infant classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Daily Report - Times and Amount of Food (26 TAC §746.2431(2))

occurrences.finding: Infant Daily Report - Times of Diaper Changes: Based on the investigation findings, this standard was reviewed and found to be in non-compliance with The Minimum Standards for Child Care Centers. The operation was not providing an infant daily report to the parents of infants ages 0-17 months old noting the times of diaper changes. The operation has since been providing this information to the parents of the children in the infant classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Daily Report - Times of Diaper Changes (26 TAC §746.2431(3))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: The outdoor play space has three active ant piles and thorny vines around the fence.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired: The a.c unit is accessible to children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired (26 TAC §746.4751(c))

occurrences.finding: Director's Absence -  Caregiver in Charge Knows in Charge: There was no person in charge. The deficiency is related to a DFPS Abuse/Neglect investigation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director's Absence -  Caregiver in Charge Knows in Charge (26 TAC §746.1013(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Director's Absence -  Caregiver in Charge Knows Responsibilities: Director did not leave a person in charge in their absence. The deficiency is related to a DFPS Abuse/Neglect investigation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director's Absence -  Caregiver in Charge Knows Responsibilities (26 TAC §746.1013(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: The provider did not report the number of employees that left in 2024 in the allotted timeframe required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: Crib Mattress Cover - Snug-Fitting and Thin: The sheets on the infant cribs were not tight fitting and created an entanglement hazard.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Crib Mattress Cover - Snug-Fitting and Thin (26 TAC §746.2415(c)(2))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Sufficient Number of Toys: Infant room had a very little selection of toys available for infant engagement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Sufficient Number of Toys (26 TAC §746.2405(5))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training: At the time of the inspection, 2 caregivers did not have pre-service training and did not have the 2 years od required experince in a regulated center.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plan - Child-Initiated - Equipment/Materials In Reach: The classrooms had little to no toys available for children to initiate play. Toys were put up out of reach and had to be retrived by a caregiver.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plan - Child-Initiated - Equipment/Materials In Reach (26 TAC §746.2206(3)(A))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Inspect Daily: The playground has multiple tripping hazards including PVC pipes and black rubber covering for the water pipe.     There are also holes on the side of the building that need to be filled and leveled out to avoid risk of tripping.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Inspect Daily (26 TAC §746.4751(a))

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: Report not submitted as of 1/16/2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: A caregiver with a pending background check was present and alone with children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: Three children's files were missing the healthcare professional statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plans - Plan Followed by Caregiver: Caregivers are expected to follow the activity plan to ensure consistency in the children's daily activities.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plans - Plan Followed by Caregiver (26 TAC §746.2203(b))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children's names and ages: A caregiver did not know the ages of the children they were responsible for.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children's names and ages (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: A child's enrollment form did not have their emergency contact's address.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Child's Food Allergy Plans: Two children's allergies were not posted in their classrooms or in the kitchen where food gets prepared.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Child's Food Allergy Plans (26 TAC §746.403(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Employees' Attendance: Two staff members did not have current attendance records on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Employees' Attendance (26 TAC §746.801(5))

occurrences.finding: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child: A caregiver did not wash their hands after diapering a child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child (26 TAC §746.3415(4))

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional: Two children with diagnosed food allergies did not have their food allergy emergency plan on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: There were loose cords hanging from a TV in the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Individual Cot, Bed, or Mat for Each Walking Child Through 4 Years of Age: A walking child was placed in a crib with a crib bed that was too high, causing risks of the child standing up and falling out, climbing out, and injuring themselves.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Individual Cot, Bed, or Mat for Each Walking Child Through 4 Years of Age (26 TAC §746.4503(a))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering: A child did not have their hands washed after diapering.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - Opening/Closing: The operation had 22 children in care with one caregiver, the youngest child was under 12 months old and the oldest was around 11 years old.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - Opening/Closing (26 TAC §746.1615)

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: It was observed a child having access to an electrical cable that was connected to a wall outlet.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Meal preparation, except when 12 or fewer children are in care: It was observed the permit  holder supervising  and providing care for the infant room and an older children's room while serving meals to the older children group.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Meal preparation, except when 12 or fewer children are in care (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(B))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area - Not Used as a Passageway: It was observed children over the age of 2 years old, walking from another room to the infant room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area - Not Used as a Passageway (26 TAC §746.2403(6))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment - Adult-sized Chair: It was observed 3 infants unsupervised while a caregiver was in a room adjacent supervising another group of children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment - Adult-sized Chair (26 TAC §746.2405(1))

occurrences.finding: Sign-in and Sign-out Tracking System: Tracking system did not have a complete information of the incoming children, did not showed the time of arrival and age of the children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sign-in and Sign-out Tracking System (26 TAC §746.631(a))

occurrences.finding: Activities for Infants - Not in Restrictive Device for more than 15 Minutes: It was observed three infants on high chairs for more that 15 minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Activities for Infants - Not in Restrictive Device for more than 15 Minutes (26 TAC §746.2417(2)(B))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: The supervision provide did not ensure each child s safety and well-being based on physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child s on going activity as appropriate.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Basic Requirements for Infants - Never Unsupervised: Infants were left unsupervised during opening hours.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Basic Requirements for Infants - Never Unsupervised (26 TAC §746.2401(7))

occurrences.finding: Complying with Laws and Rules: The permit holder did not comply with Lawas and Rules, by not providing children supervision that ensure safety of all children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Complying with Laws and Rules (26 TAC §746.201(9))

occurrences.finding: Diapering Procedures - Sanitizing Diaper Changing Area: Caregiver did not sanitize the diaper changing surface after changing a diaper.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diapering Procedures - Sanitizing Diaper Changing Area (26 TAC §746.3505(e))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering: A child did not have their hands washed after diapering.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))

occurrences.finding: Report Outbreak of Communicable Illness: The operation did not notify licensing of a positive COVID-19 case.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Outbreak of Communicable Illness (26 TAC §746.305(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Waterproof, Washable Mattress: A crib mattress was torn up with tape covering the tears making the mattress not washable.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Waterproof, Washable Mattress (26 TAC §746.2409(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: People Whose Behavior/Health Threatens Children Not Present: The center staff was present at the center, exposing other staff and children, while being positive for COVID-19.
occurrences.violation_type_title: People Whose Behavior/Health Threatens Children Not Present (26 TAC §746.3703(a))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Secure Supports: A child was sleeping in a crib with loose hardware. The child and mattress had sunken almost reaching the floor.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Secure Supports (26 TAC §746.2409(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting Sheets: A crib did not have a snug fitted sheet covering the mattress.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting Sheets (26 TAC §746.2409(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child: Caregiver did not wash hands after changing a diaper.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child (26 TAC §746.3415(4))
